# setup_game_assets

[← Command index](README.md)

Link the Pegasus frontend's asset folders to the artwork in the locker.

## Synopsis

```
setup_game_assets [options]
```

## Description

Walks every game category and subcategory and, for each asset type (box art,
screenshots, backgrounds and so on), creates a symlink from the Pegasus metadata
asset directory to the matching artwork directory in the locker. A locker artwork
directory that does not exist yet is created first, so every link has a target.

Run it after building game metadata, or whenever the asset directory layout changes.
It takes only the common options.

## Options

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Create all asset symlinks

```bash
setup_game_assets -v
```

### Preview without making changes

```bash
setup_game_assets -p -v
```

## Notes

- Symlinks must be supported on the system; the requirement check exits otherwise.
- Missing artwork directories are created, so the command is safe to re-run.
- It stops at the first symlink that cannot be created.
